newsitem.title: USA: Sure Shot says Isiah Thomas to be chairman.
newsitem.headline: Sure Shot says Isiah Thomas to be chairman.

text.p: Sure Shot International Inc said Monday that former basketball player Isiah Thomas has signed a letter of intent to acquire a majority interest in the company and become board chairman.

Thomas, part owner of the Toronto Raptors basketball team and its general manager, is to form an entity that will invest $1.5 million in cash in exchange for 4.5 million shares of Sure Shot's common stock.
The company said Thomas and the newly formed entity also would have the potential to buy up to one million additional shares.
Thomas would succeed Harry Bachmann, who would remain president of the company.
